checklist: Q3 / S6 (STRESS-MATRIX 5, Quit with a hung page): Quit asks the page how many keepers are unsaved (LuminaAppDelegate → SetsRootView.unsavedKeepers) and gives up after 2 s. The probe asks this page the same question through the app's own SetsFirstAnswer with the app's 2 s timeout: answered at once while the page runs (2 unsaved keepers), and the fallback 0 after about 2 s while the page's main thread is held in a busy loop. Not covered here: the app delegate's .terminateLater / reply and the process actually exiting (a hand check in docs/release/stress/Q3-lifecycle.md).

steps.why: the page carries on once the busy loop ends
